key_points: Pfizer's experimental eczema drug met mid-stage efficacy endpoint with 62.5% achieving ≥75% improvement.
Positive data adds near-term pipeline momentum amid ongoing COVID‑19 sales decline.
Dividend yield remains attractive (~6%) supported by strong balance sheet.
Valuation appears elevated relative to peers; patent‑cliff risks persist for key assets.
Overall outlook hinges on converting early‑stage success into later‑stage milestones.
